issues.issue: ending_cash uses the single 'Cash and cash equivalents' line only. The rule says cash and cash equivalents/investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet, so the CDs and county treasurer cash (and possibly the restricted cash) could arguably be included. The notes disclose this choice.

issues.on_page: Franchise fees 1,480,043 (Electric 1,357,021 + Water 123,022); General Fund revenue 'Taxes: Franchise' 1,480,043 (p5)
issues.issue: The utilities' franchise-fee expense exactly equals the General Fund franchise tax revenue. It is an internal payment from the utilities to the General Fund, reported under GAAP as tax/expense rather than as a transfer. It is recorded correctly as printed, but a person may want to know it inflates both sides.
